prompt: Create an original 180 second West African acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: kora, balafon, calabash percussion. Style: interlocking plucked patterns and buoyant polyrhythm. Tempo approximately 96 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A serene and traditional East Asian-inspired instrumental piece featuring plucked strings, subtle percussion, and a gentle flute melody, creating a calm and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静的东亚风格器乐曲，以弹拨乐器、轻柔的打击乐和悠扬的笛声为主，营造出平静而沉思的氛围。
